description: This file defines a custom PHPUnit comparator for asserting equality of Enum objects from the MyCLabs Enum library. It provides a way to get more informative output when comparing enum instances in unit tests.

classes.name: Comparator
classes.description: Custom PHPUnit comparator for comparing Enum instances, providing formatted output and precise assertions.

methods.name: accepts
methods.description: Checks if both arguments are instances of Enum or null, indicating whether this comparator can handle the comparison.

methods.name: assertEquals
methods.description: Asserts that two Enum objects are equal, throwing ComparisonFailure with detailed formatted output if they are not.

methods.name: formatEnum
methods.description: Formats an Enum object into a string representation, including the class name and key, or returns 'null' for null inputs.
